universal_principles.title: Equality and Dignity
universal_principles.description: All human beings are born free and equal in dignity and rights. They are endowed with reason and conscience and should act towards one another in a spirit of brotherhood.
universal_principles.source: Universal Declaration of Human Rights, Article 1

universal_principles.title: Non-Discrimination
universal_principles.description: Everyone is entitled to all the rights and freedoms set forth in this Declaration, without distinction of any kind, such as race, colour, sex, language, religion, political or other opinion, national or social origin, property, birth or other status.
universal_principles.source: Universal Declaration of Human Rights, Article 2

universal_principles.title: Right to Life
universal_principles.description: Everyone has the right to life, liberty and security of person.
universal_principles.source: Universal Declaration of Human Rights, Article 3

universal_principles.title: Privacy Protection
universal_principles.description: No one shall be subjected to arbitrary interference with his privacy, family, home or correspondence, nor to attacks upon his honour and reputation. Everyone has the right to the protection of the law against such interference or attacks.
universal_principles.source: Universal Declaration of Human Rights, Article 12

universal_principles.title: Freedom of Opinion
universal_principles.description: Everyone has the right to freedom of opinion and expression. This right includes freedom to hold opinions without interference and to seek, receive and impart information and ideas through any media and regardless of frontiers.
universal_principles.source: Universal Declaration of Human Rights, Article 19

universal_principles.title: Scientific Progress
universal_principles.description: Everyone has the right freely to participate in the cultural life of the community, to enjoy the arts and to share in scientific advancement and its benefits.
universal_principles.source: Universal Declaration of Human Rights, Article 27

modern_rights.title: Right to Privacy in Digital Age
modern_rights.description: Everyone has the right to privacy, including in digital communications and data processing

modern_rights.title: Freedom of Expression Online
modern_rights.description: Everyone has the right to freedom of opinion and expression, including through digital media

modern_rights.title: Right to Digital Access
modern_rights.description: Everyone has the right to access digital technologies and the internet

modern_rights.title: Protection from Algorithmic Discrimination
modern_rights.description: Everyone has the right to be protected from discriminatory algorithmic decision-making

modern_rights.title: Right to Digital Dignity
modern_rights.description: Everyone has the right to dignity and respect in digital interactions and representations

modern_rights.title: Right to Data Protection
modern_rights.description: Everyone has the right to the protection of personal data concerning them
modern_rights.source: European Union Charter of Fundamental Rights

modern_rights.title: Right to Non-Discrimination in AI
modern_rights.description: Any discrimination based on grounds such as sex, racial or ethnic origin, religion, disability, age or sexual orientation shall be prohibited
modern_rights.source: European Union Charter of Fundamental Rights

modern_rights.title: Right to Explainability in Automated Decisions
modern_rights.description: Everyone has the right to obtain an explanation of automated decisions made about them
modern_rights.source: European Union Charter of Fundamental Rights

modern_rights.title: Protection from Digital Surveillance
modern_rights.description: Governments must protect citizens from unlawful digital surveillance and data collection

modern_rights.title: Right to Internet Freedom
modern_rights.description: Everyone has the right to access and share information online without government censorship

modern_rights.title: Protection from Online Harassment
modern_rights.description: Everyone has the right to be protected from online harassment, hate speech, and digital violence

modern_rights.title: Right to Digital Assembly
modern_rights.description: Everyone has the right to peaceful assembly and association online

civic_principles.title: Democratic Participation
civic_principles.description: All individuals have the right to participate in democratic processes and civic engagement without barriers. AI systems should facilitate rather than hinder democratic participation.

civic_principles.title: Community Building
civic_principles.description: AI systems should support community building and social cohesion, fostering connections between people and strengthening community bonds.

civic_principles.title: Transparency and Accountability
civic_principles.description: AI systems must operate transparently and be accountable for their decisions and actions. Users should understand how decisions are made and have recourse for errors.

civic_principles.title: Ethical Innovation
civic_principles.description: Technological innovation must be guided by ethical considerations and serve human wellbeing. AI should enhance rather than diminish human capabilities and dignity.
